# gramlot-examples 0.3.44

- Terminal trial (`trials/terminal`, family `94-terminal`): the `terminal` component of gramlot 0.3.36 with an echo session, and a local shell offered only in development (`GRAMLOT_DEV`) to a loopback peer. It runs on a Python host with `--websocket`.
- Documentation gallery (`documentation_gallery`): a separate gallery of static examples for the Sphinx manual; the docs build exports three of its pages for the core manual.
- Requires gramlot 0.3.36.
